verdict.rationale: Termius ships its own in-product AI feature: it generates shell commands from plain-language descriptions (docs-6, docs-45). This is an AI suggestion inside the product, but it works from the user's prompt rather than producing insights from the user's own data. Data-driven autocomplete from shell history, snippets and paths exists (docs-24), but it is not described as AI. Missing for 10: AI analysis or insights over user data such as session logs, hosts or history; documentation of AI suggestions grounded in user data; independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI feature.
